node_definition.done_when: The roadmap lifts the resolved, unsatisfied cross-plan section edges that _section_scoped_edges in reckon/roadmap.py already produces into the graph the roadmap closes over (local_graph and dependents), so the existing unlocks and the longest_path walk see them; the path is weighted by each open section's effort_hours, and no second resolver is written. critical_path and open_paths gain a sections list beside their plans. New tests in tests/test_the_critical_path_runs_through_sections.py pass: a synthetic three-plan fixture whose only cross-plan wiring is plan-section-depends-on A#s2 to B#s3 to C#s1 reports a critical path naming those three sections in that order with their summed effort, and reports C in B's unlocks. The gate log shows those tests failing on the base commit, where the path is a single plan and unlocks is empty. On power_convertor (mounted, read-only) the roadmap's critical path at the worker's head spans at least two plans and names iter-switched-terminal-transients#s6; the gate log records that output with the head revision it ran at. reckon/roadmap.py is near the module width bound, so tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py must pass; if the change would push it over, move whole existing helpers into a sibling module in the same node rather than allowlisting. Gate, run in place on the fleet allocation with its log under the run directory: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_the_critical_path_runs_through_sections.py tests/test_roadmap.py tests/test_roadmap_reports_section_edges.py tests/test_roadmap_deferred_blocks_only_its_dependents.py tests/test_roadmap_endpoints.py tests/test_roadmap_unwired_plan.py tests/test_shadow_pick_off_critical_path.py tests/test_mcp_roadmap.py tests/test_finished_plan_reads_closable.py tests/test_gates_on_finished_work_release.py tests/test_a_section_gate_holds_its_sections.py tests/test_the_roadmap_lists_come_out_in_one_order.py tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py, judged by failure delta against the base revision; ruff check and ruff format --check clean on the changed paths.
